title: Operator
description: A person licensed to drive a Vehicle. Modeled as role+credential. No performance or disciplinary data belongs in this entity.

badge.description: Agency-local operator id (opaque). Never log a human name without consent.

tenureCohort.description: Derived from hireDate and the agency's cohort definitions. Used only for cohort-level analytics (e.g. new-operator coaching), never for per-person scoring.
